verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Modal can attach several GPUs to one container (`:n`), lets you fan out embarrassingly parallel work over thousands of GPUs, and grants access without quota requests. None of this documents provisioning a multi-node cluster with fast interconnect (e.g., InfiniBand/RDMA) for distributed training. Single-container multi-GPU and parallel fan-out are adjacent capabilities, not interconnected multi-node clusters, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can provision a multi-node GPU cluster with fast interconnect for distributed training without a sales cycle
